1.Nf3 d5 2.c4 e6 3.g3 Nf6 4.Bg2 c6.name: English Opening: Agincourt Defence, Catalan Defence, Semi-Slav Defence

1.Nf3 d5 2.c4 e6 3.g3 Nf6 4.Bg2 c6 5.b3.strategy: Protects the c4-pawn and prepares the queen's bishop for the long diagonal, keeping the pawn structure flexible instead of building a pawn centre at once. White keeps c4 solid and aims at the centre from a distance.

Develops the bishop to its natural square and prepares castling, while the pawns on c6, d5 and e6 stay as they are. Black chooses a solid, slightly passive set-up and waits for White to show a plan; the c8-bishop still has to be freed later.
